mandatory_limits: Historical Gland July1997 source approved21January1998 only; publication/reference in current municipal FAQ does not establish present validity of every measure. Registry plan_status and5721 mapping remain unverified.
Existing French170dpi researchOCR is uncorrected; no recognition-confidence or certified page claim. Exact physical-page citations and original image remain authoritative.
Selected prose is a historical search aid, not normalized structured measures, zoning rights, present capacities, available land or permission to build.

Headings and objective/measure lists on accepted pages retain raw order; minor OCR glyph/unit errors remain. Do not turn OCR section numbers or quantitative prose into structured facts without checking images.
Mixed illustrated pages preserve only raw OCR text; figures/maps/legends/spatial relationships are not completely represented or qualified.
Bilan physical10 explicitly describes effective occupation rather than legal soil status. Bilan4 says measures are proposed means to implement objectives.
1990s population, infrastructure, traffic forecasts and land reserves are source-vintage descriptions, not current capacity. Terms actuel/aujourd’hui/en cours remain dated to source.

Mesures25 explicitly distinguishes realized and unused projects at source date. Mesures40 explicitly says some projects in1989illustration were already realized. These cannot be counted as new/current projects.
La Falaise density reference, Lignière surface/setback, GrandChamp77,913m2 and EnBord73,000/65,000m2 are historical conditional source statements, not current parcel rights or residual capacity.
No new geometry, parcel attribution, spatial qualification, commune completion or national completion.
